family: The single total certificate-free language in proof.md and family.py, with fixed STRENGTH=2^850 and delta=2^(-850). Exact delayed-constant root guards define zero at failed shapes. Otherwise every actual input bit is payload for the balanced-tree challenge-response construction. Its half-rate component is the mixed relative-trace cubic Tr_(K/L)(x^3+nu*x^7) over explicit power-of-two quadratic-tower fields; small design fields are deterministically searched. All choices are uniform, no field-polynomial prefix or advice is supplied, and the fixed polynomial runtime exponent is enormous.
theorem: For this one fixed total language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8*N^(2^(-850))-8 for every sufficiently large integer actual length N in the full pinned B2 model. The same complete guarantee implies liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. Every construction, subfield case, gate reduction and guard is proved; strength is fixed and no subpolynomial-remainder endpoint is asserted.
